snippet.title: Vultures - Scavengers of Death | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Vultures - Scavengers of Death
VULTURES is a tactical turn-based survival horror, inspired by 90's survival horror classics. As an operative, scavenge the infested metropolis for materials and information that could cure the infection plaguing the world.
